title: Deposit on Approval of a Network or Server Order: Amount and Rounding
content:
**Clause.** A deposit is required on an infrastructure approval, the approval of a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote, when the quote total is at least the order type's deposit threshold, and the standard infrastructure deposit is then the order type's deposit percentage of the quote total. Both order types have a deposit threshold of 0.00 USD and a deposit percentage of 50 percent, the figures shown for them in the deposit terms, so every such approval requires a deposit.

**Build.** The deposit percentage is applied to the quote total.

**Rounding.** The infrastructure deposit is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

The quote total, quantity, unit price and distributor unit cost are those on the quote being signed.

## Worked cases (hypothetical quote totals)

| Order type | Quote total | Deposit percentage | Unrounded | Deposit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Equipment Order | 9000.00 | 50 | 4500.00 | 4500.00 |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 12345.67 | 50 | 6172.835 | 6172.84 |
